Synopsis:
    China has restored road access to the Tibet disaster zone one week after catastrophic flooding destroyed sections of the G216 highway near the Gyirong-Nepal border crossing. Heavy machinery and rescue teams with life-detection equipment are now on site. The official Chinese toll stands at 16 dead and 546 missing (including 104 Indians, 49 Nepalis, 33 Latvians). Nepal reports 1,114 dead and ~4,000 unaccounted for. Ongoing risks include persistent rain, landslides, and unstable upstream lakes. Foreign media access to the Tibetan disaster zone remains restricted by Chinese authorities.
